summary: Aside from sharing a meaningful message at the 2026 Asean Inclusive Growth Summit, Broadway superstar Lea Salonga also brought her powerful vocals to the event and sang “Tagumpay Nating Lahat.”…

blocks.text: Aside from sharing a meaningful message at the 2026 Asean Inclusive Growth Summit, Broadway superstar Lea Salonga also brought her powerful vocals to the event and sang “Tagumpay Nating Lahat.” The acclaimed theater actress belted out the classic song, drawing applause from the attendees on Wednesday, Nov. 11. A video of her performance was shared by author and journalist Yvette Fernandez through her Facebook page.
